topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the final lecture of the course by welcoming students and setting out the core learning objectives on cancer therapies.

topics.label: Conventional Cancer Therapies and Cytotoxic Chemotherapy
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine non-targeted modalities for debulking and killing cancer cells, highlighting the mechanisms, systemic toxicities, and drug-resistance pathways of cytotoxic chemotherapy.

topics.label: Exploiting Intrinsic Cancer Cell Vulnerabilities
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore therapeutic strategies that exploit intrinsic molecular dependencies of cancer cells, including hormone receptor requirements, cell cycle checkpoint defects, and impaired DNA repair.

topics.label: Oncogene Addiction and Small-Molecule Kinase Inhibitors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss the rationale, clinical applications, and diverse resistance mechanisms associated with small-molecule kinase inhibitors targeting driver oncogenes.

topics.label: Therapeutic Antibodies and Antibody-Drug Conjugates
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the design and therapeutic actions of engineered monoclonal antibodies that target cancer cell surface antigens either to recruit immune effectors or to selectively deliver cytotoxic drugs.

topics.label: Cancer Immunotherapy and T-Cell Modulation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine cancer immunotherapy strategies centered on mobilizing, disinhibiting, or genetically engineering T cells to eliminate tumors.

topics.label: Overarching Challenges, Progress, and Future Directions in Cancer Care
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the broader clinical trajectory of cancer care, reviewing pervasive challenges, long-term survival trends, and future therapeutic and ethical priorities.
